_comment: How scripts/markets.sh and the services run on Monad mainnet. settlementFeeds: listing = the Chainlink feeds in config/monad-mainnet.<product>.json (push feeds are refused here). kuruBooks: none = Kuru's mainnet factory is owner-gated, so roll lists the options and writes their option-token addresses; Kuru deploys the books; `markets.sh register` registers them. execution: propose = roles are multisigs: the script writes every role call to deployments/monad-mainnet.*.proposals.json and sends nothing. vol: market-derived (Deribit) for WETH; MON has no listed options to calibrate to, so its vol source must be decided before listing (null = the script refuses). expiries: Deribit-aligned daily and weekly (08:00 UTC), which the publisher can calibrate without arbitrage. Before mainnet: fill the publisher addresses in the product configs, set multisig roles in config/monad-mainnet.json, and use a Pyth plan that covers every product's feeds.
